description: Defines the LoanScheduleModelRepaymentPeriod class representing a repayment period in a loan schedule, including properties, constructors, and methods for handling loan repayment data.

classes.name: LoanScheduleModelRepaymentPeriod
classes.description: Represents a loan repayment period with details such as dates, amounts, and interest recalculations.

methods.name: repayment
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of LoanScheduleModelRepaymentPeriod with specified parameters.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the object to LoanSchedulePeriodData format.

methods.name: isRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Indicates this is a repayment period.

methods.name: isDownPaymentPeriod
methods.description: Indicates this is not a down payment period.

methods.name: periodNumber
methods.description: Returns the period number.

methods.name: periodFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the period.

methods.name: periodDueDate
methods.description: Returns the due date of the period.

methods.name: principalDue
methods.description: Returns the principal due amount.

methods.name: interestDue
methods.description: Returns the interest due amount.

methods.name: feeChargesDue
methods.description: Returns the fee charges due.

methods.name: penaltyChargesDue
methods.description: Returns the penalty charges due.

methods.name: addLoanCharges
methods.description: Adds fee and penalty charges to the period.

methods.name: addPrincipalAmount
methods.description: Adds principal amount to the period.

methods.name: addInterestAmount
methods.description: Adds interest amount to the period.

methods.name: setPeriodNumber
methods.description: Sets the period number.

methods.name: setOutstandingLoanBalance
methods.description: Sets the outstanding loan balance.

methods.name: getLoanCompoundingDetails
methods.description: Returns loan interest recalculation details.

methods.name: isEMIFixedSpecificToInstallment
methods.description: Checks if EMI is fixed for this installment.

methods.name: setEMIFixedSpecificToInstallmentTrue
methods.description: Sets EMI fixed specific to installment to true.

methods.name: setRescheduleInterestPortion
methods.description: Sets the reschedule interest portion.

methods.name: rescheduleInterestPortion
methods.description: Returns the reschedule interest portion.
